# GooseJobs

> GooseJobs is an AI-powered job application management platform that helps job seekers search, tailor, track, and manage their entire job hunt in one workspace.

## Summary

GooseJobs combines three tools job seekers typically use separately: a multi-board job aggregator, a Kanban application tracker, and an AI copilot for resume and cover letter generation. It is currently in private beta and requires an invite code to access.

URL: https://goosejobs.vercel.app/enter

## Core Features

- **AI Job Search**: Searches 25+ job boards in a single query. Sources include LinkedIn, Indeed, Google Jobs, Glassdoor, Remotive, WeWorkRemotely, Hacker News (Who's Hiring), Himalayas, Jobicy, Landing.jobs, Arbeitnow, EURES (EU Employment Services), No-Fluff Jobs (Poland), DevITjobs.eu, Greenhouse (direct ATS), Lever (direct ATS), Ashby (direct ATS), JSearch, Adzuna, USAJobs (US federal), Y Combinator jobs, Reed.co.uk (UK), Careerjet, TheirStack, and 4 Day Week. Results are re-ranked by AI (bi-encoder + cross-encoder) based on the user's resume and desired role.

- **Application Pipeline**: A Kanban-style tracker with columns: Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Rejected. Each card stores job details, the resume version submitted, the cover letter, notes, and activity log. Supports drag-and-drop between stages.

- **AI Copilot**: A chat interface for resume tailoring (paste a job description, get a tailored resume), cover letter generation, interview question prep, and application strategy feedback. Powered by Google Gemini.

- **Document Vault**: Stores multiple versions of the user's resume. Supports PDF upload and text extraction for AI processing.

## Target Audience

Job seekers in the United States and European Union, particularly in tech and knowledge-work fields. Strong coverage for Germany, France, UK, Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, and other EU countries.

## Technical Details

- Frontend: Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Python (FastAPI), SQLite
- AI: Google Gemini (language generation), Sentence Transformers (bi-encoder ranking), cross-encoder reranking
- Job data: Aggregated from 25+ sources via direct APIs; no scraping
- Embedding cache: SQLite-backed cache keyed by content hash to avoid redundant API calls

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What makes GooseJobs different from standard job boards?**
GooseJobs aggregates listings from 25+ boards simultaneously and ranks them by AI relevance against your own resume — so you see jobs matched to your actual profile, not generic keyword results. It also keeps all your applications, tailored documents, and communications in one place.

**Does GooseJobs work for remote jobs?**
Yes. It includes dedicated remote-only boards (Remotive, WeWorkRemotely, Himalayas, Jobicy, Working Nomads) as well as a source specifically for 4-day-work-week companies.

**Does GooseJobs work outside the US?**
Yes. GooseJobs includes EU-specific sources (EURES, Arbeitnow, No-Fluff Jobs, DevITjobs.eu, Reed.co.uk, Arbeitsagentur for Germany) and regional coverage for most major EU countries. Coverage for North Africa and the Middle East is limited.

**Can GooseJobs tailor my resume automatically?**
Yes. The AI copilot reads a job description and your existing resume, then rewrites bullet points and adjusts language to match the role's requirements and improve ATS pass rates.

**Is GooseJobs free?**
GooseJobs is currently in private beta. Access requires an invite code. Future pricing has not been announced.

**What job types does GooseJobs cover?**
Full-time, part-time, contract, freelance, and internship positions. Remote, hybrid, and on-site. Entry-level through senior roles. Strongest coverage in software engineering, data, product, design, marketing, and operations.

## Access

Private beta. Invite code required at: https://goosejobs.vercel.app/enter
